# `format_number`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Formats the number `expr1` like '#,###,###.##', rounded to `expr2`
decimal places. If `expr2` is 0, the result has no decimal point or fractional part.
`expr2` also accept a user specified format.
This is supposed to function like MySQL's FORMAT.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
format_number(expr1, expr2)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- format_number, example 1
> SELECT format_number(12332.123456, 4);
12,332.1235
```

```sql
-- format_number, example 2
> SELECT format_number(12332.123456, '##################.###');
12332.123
```
